ranking_basis: Top 50 distinct model identities by their first appearance in the official Intelligence Index leaderboard. rank is the best displayed source row; model_rank is distinct-identity ordinal. Effort, fallback, and non-reasoning variants are grouped. Displayed integer-score ties preserve source order.
configuration_policy: Variant effort fields identify benchmark configurations only. Never automatically apply them to provider calls or change reasoning/spend settings.
